title: Derive equilibrium-preserving momentum-dependent chi1-electron and neutrino thermal collision operator; compute drag/diffusion and SM Q
objective: From the chosen gauge-qualified vector EFT or an explicit UV portal, derive the finite-T collision integral C_el[f_chi1] for moving chi1, including Pauli blocking of both species, detailed balance for FD chi, and correct SM energy/number accounting. Compare the linearized kinetic relaxation eigenmodes or drag coefficient with the existing phenomenological number-conserving BGK; avoid equating rest transport frequency or recoil heat with gamma_el.
prerequisites: Check latest CI and PR head; read GOAL, STATE, EVIDENCE, BACKLOG
Read kinetics/MICROPHYSICS-MODEL.md, microphysics_portal.py, microphysics_recoil_heat.py and their real tests
Check the scalar Yukawa 1<->2 and Dirac charges/gamma conventions against pinned BEST and explicit primary physical sources
steps: Write down fully differential Lorentz invariant 2->2 collision source including initial f_chi f_e, final-state (1-f_chi')(1-f_e') and inverse process, correct energy transfer Q and both signs
Check gauge invariant electroweak lepton doublet completion, neutrino contributions and required UV cutoff before applying above EWSB; quantify neglected electron mass and screening

Derive analytically exact equilibrium C_el=0 for common T and chemical potentials and conservation of chi number, total dark+SM energy and momentum, then implement independent quadrature reference for representative moving momenta

Extract physically correct momentum-drag/diffusion or relaxation eigenvalue by linearization around equilibrium, report domain and numerical error vs q/angular/thermal grid; test against rest-particle heating limit and no-block reference
Only with measured error bars consider a calibrated BGK projection; prove same kinetic relaxation/number/heat moments and show when scalar gamma is invalid
Execute tests and appropriate public CI; add new evidence including failures; checkpoint and commit/push then immediately select another bottleneck
acceptance: Full Lorentz invariant elastic 2->2 collision source and physical energy/number moment; no hidden temperature reset
Detailed balance at common T and exact zero coupling; Pauli positivity and both-sign energy flow under perturbations
Independent analytic or numerical reference, q/time/angle convergence and preserved failures with measurable error budgets
No use of nu_T(rest) or Q_rest as gamma_el without derivation/calibration
Document UV/gauge and thermodynamic approximation validity
fallback: If full moving-particle 9D collision integral is too expensive, derive a controlled small-transfer Fokker–Planck kernel, assess its domain and compare to a low-dimensional exact collision reference
If UV completion requires missing species, explicitly enlarge model and stoichiometric charge ledger
If CI/blocking problem occurs, maintain independent analytic threshold and chemical-affinity tests and record blocker
deliverables: controlled reduced numerical reference and compact JSON
updated checkpoints and next science stage
scope_notes: The current completed pilots are tree-level EFT and rest-test-particle observables only. A physical 86 eV relic or CLASS input is not yet computed.
external_action_policy: Only GitHub research branch, no force push/merge. Public Actions allowed compactly. No Computer Use/PC without explicit user approval.
resume_instructions: Start from this file and explicit STATE/CI SHA, choose kernel/phase-space parameterization, independently verify detailed balance before using it to replace phenomenological BGK.
